top_signals.title: Cysic suspends bridge after attacker mints tokens and moves $727,000 to Ethereum
top_signals.summary: The attacker, after minting 10 million CYS, managed to bridge about $727,000 in proceeds to Ethereum through Mayan, deBridge and SWFT's Bridgers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
